Uh, morning. Where are you two fine gentlemen heading?

Mrs. Liu is very strict about breakfast hours.
All right. You have a good day.

Mrs. Liu always likes to try

Ah, that's... Thank you. That's very nice.

she's the one with the husband the...
the other night in the clinic?

What are you doing out here?

there was this weird fucking symbol right on the ceiling.

No. Uh, we're just here for a little bit.

Like Norman had to go on to the Lake of Tears?

That's what Norman had to do.
Yeah, you might be onto something there.

That he's on a magical quest,
and if I try, I can help him save the kingdom.

Oh, I don't think they'll understand.
There's something I need to show you,
You remember the boy that you were talking about?
What is this? What're you doing?
Dad, stop! What are you doing?
You don't talk to him. Do you understand me?
The only thing you say right now is "Yes." Okay?
Stay the fuck away from him.
There you are. Been looking everywhere for you.
Um, I think maybe I made a mistake.
It was hard for me too at first.
It helped once I figured out
how to get my clothes back from Trudy.
Well, she's wearing a new T-shirt

Take it easy on that leg or you're gonna pop a stitch.
You see that one right there?

Oh, God, he was this amazing cross-dresser.
Oh, he was so beautiful and funny.
Well, Trudy got her hands on it,
and now she's always trying to hide it,
so she doesn't have to share it with anybody.
It's up for grabs! Here, put it on.
Well, I think Charlie would agree
it would look much better on you than it does on Trudy.
If you want, I can go talk...
No, it's fine. I got it.
What are you doing up here?
Well, I found your sweater in my bag.
Honey, this is not a prison. You can leave whenever you want.
you know, you made a mistake, that you've changed your mind.
Why do you always do that?
poor, stupid Julie doesn't understand what she's doing
and that everything will just be okay

I didn't say that. I didn't say that.

We love you and Ethan very, very much.
And I know that it's hard,
and I know that you lost, but we all lost.

It's not that simple! It's not that simple!

is where you and your friend were driving

and I'm not gonna rest until I figure out how.

so eventually they break. Jade, look,
every new person who comes here just assumes

but that's not the hardest part.

what it makes you think and feel,
what it makes you question about every single thing
that you think you know, and-and if you can't if you...

Well, you look how I feel.

Well, as well as you'd expect.

That you're hurt, that you're scared.
That this is all so fucked that you have no idea what to do,
because I am walking around, reminding myself to breathe,
and every time you talk about
how things are going to be okay, it makes the rest of us feel

No. You don't get to do that.
We wouldn't even be here if we hadn't...

What was this trip supposed to do, Jim?
What did you think was gonna happen?
That we were gonna go camping for a few days

just like he chose me once.

very careful about what you say next.

You made it possible for people here to live again,
I can still see her face when I close my eyes.
what it must be like for you,

And that's where the sermon ends.

Mm. We shouldn't talk about that.

I used to have a little brother.

I don't want to know that stuff.

No, no, no, no, no, no.

or it could be that you end up stuck inside
